You can easily download your official receipt directly from your account:

* Sign in to your **customer dashboard**.
* Go to your payment history.
* Once a staff member has verified your uploaded proof of payment, you will see your official receipt (with an OR number format like OR-000000) ready for download.

If you have any trouble finding your receipt or need assistance with a payment, please feel free to reach out to us at our office or through our 24/7 line at **0917-123-4567**, and our team will be glad to help you.
